traits.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
traits.text: Can communicate with Beasts and Plants as if they shared a language.

traits.name: Woodland Walk
traits.text: Difficult terrain made of plants doesn’t cost hag extra move. Can pass through plants with o being slowed by them nor taking damage from them if they have thorns spines or similar.

actions.name: Nettling Word
actions.text: Heckles mocks or jeers one creature she can see within 30' of her. If creature can hear and understand her enraged until end of its next turn (DC 16 Cha negates). While enraged: advantage on melee attacks unable to distinguish friend from foe and must move to and attack nearest creature (not hag). If none is near enough to move to and attack enraged creature stalks off in random direction. Attacks vs. enraged creature: advantage.

traits.name: Limited Telepathy
traits.text: Magically transmit simple messages and images to any creature within 90' of it that can understand a language. This telepathy doesn't allow receiver to telepathically respond.

traits.name: Virulence
traits.text: A creature infected with harpy's plague becomes contagious 24 hrs after contracting the disease. When a creature starts its turn within 5 ft. of contagious target that creature must make DC 15 Con save or also contract harpy's plague disease.

traits.name: Beast of Burden
traits.text: Is considered one size larger for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.

traits.name: Construct Nature
traits.text: Doesn’t require air food drink or sleep.

traits.name: Poor Traversal
traits.text: Must spend two additional feet of movement to move through difficult terrain instead of one additional foot.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.text: Double damage to objects/structures.

traits.name: Herd-Hidden (Herd Animal Form Only)
traits.text: Has advantage on Dex (Stealth) and Cha (Deception) checks to blend into herd or convince those observing herd it is part of the herd.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.text: Has advantage on Wis (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: One of the Herd
traits.text: A domesticated herd animal such as a cow horse sheep or chicken that can see the herd skulker treats it as a member of the herd regardless of the form skulker takes. When such an animal sees a herd skulker attack or feed it becomes immune to herd skulker’s One of the Herd for the next 24 hrs acting as it normally would when confronting a predator. Creatures immune to the charmed condition are immune to this.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.text: Transforms into a Large or smaller domesticated herd animal it can see such as a cow horse sheep or chicken or back into its true canine form. Its statistics other than its size are the same in each form. Reverts on death.

actions.name: Nimble Escape
actions.text: Takes the Disengage or Hide action.

traits.name: Aura of Misfortune
traits.text: Creatures within 15 ft. of it treat attack rolls of 20 as 19 and can’t gain advantage on ability checks attacks and saves.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.text: While hinderling curse remains on a victim a slain hinderling returns to life in 1 day regaining all its hp and becoming active again. Hinderling appears within 100' of victim.

actions.name: Nimble Escape
actions.text: Takes the Disengage or Hide action.

actions.name: Run and Hide
actions.text: When a creature hinderling can see targets it with weapon hinderling chooses another creature within 5 ft. as attack's target then moves up to half its speed with o provoking opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Divine Awareness
traits.text: Knows if it hears a lie.

traits.name: Divine Jaws
traits.text: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with Gore Gore deals extra 2d8 necrotic or radiant (included) hippo’s choice.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.text: Can hold its breath for 30 min.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

traits.name: Sacred Guardian
traits.text: Can pinpoint the location of an agent or worshiper of an opposing deity or a creature with ill intent toward its sacred site within 120' of itself. In addition it can sense when such a creature moves within 100' of the site and can sense general direction of such creatures within 1 mile of the site.

actions.name: Protector's Step
actions.text: Magically teleports with any items worn/carried up to 120' to unoccupied space within its sacred site or within 30' of exterior of its site. Golden light swirls or inky shadown tendrils (hippo's choice) appear at origin and destination.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: Can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Blood Scent
traits.text: Advantage on Wis (Perception) and Wis (Survival) checks to find or track a creature that doesn’t have all its hp.

actions.name: Hidden Predator
actions.text: Takes the Hide action.

name: Howler Of The Hill
languages: understands Abyssal, Common, Infernal, and Void Speech but can't speak, telepathy 120'

traits.name: Hungry Void Traveler
traits.text: Doesn’t require air drink or sleep.

traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.text: Immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts and any divination spell it refuses. Wis (Insight) checks made to ascertain its intentions/sincerity have disadvantage.

traits.name: Echolocation (Whale Form Only)
traits.text: No blindsight while deafened.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.text: Can hold its breath for 1 hr.

traits.name: Speak with Cetaceans
traits.text: Can communicate with dolphins porpoises and whales as if they shared a language.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.text: Transforms into Huge frost giant Huge whale or back into its true whale-giant hybrid form. Its stats are the same in each form. Items worn/carried transform with it. Reverts on death.

actions.name: Reel Anchor
actions.text: Pulls on the chain connected to anchor returning it to its empty hand. If anchor is hooked around a creature creature: DC 19 Str save or be pulled up to 30' toward hvalfiskr.

traits.name: Fiery Blood
traits.text: When it takes damage each creature within 5 ft. of it: DC 15 Dex save or take 3 (1d6) fire. The fire ignites flammable objects within 5 ft. of ibexian that aren’t being worn or carried.

traits.name: Fiery Charge
traits.text: If it moves 20'+ straight toward a target and then hits it with Ram attack on the same turn target takes extra 7 (2d6) fire. If target is a creature it must make DC 15 Str save or be pushed up to 10 ft. away and knocked prone.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: Advantage on attacks vs. creature if 1+ unincapacitated attacker ally is within 5 ft. of target.

traits.name: Fear of Fire

If presented forcefully with fire or if it is dealt fire the ice urchin must make DC 13 Wis save or become frightened until the end of its next turn. Once it has been frightened by a specific source of fire (such as a torch) the ice urchin can’t be frightened by that same source again for 24 hrs.

traits.name: Ice Slide
traits.text: Its speed increases to 60' when it moves on snow or ice. Additionally difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn’t cost it extra movement.

traits.name: Melting Away
traits.text: If it takes fire damage its AC is reduced by 2 and it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Spiny Defense
traits.text: A creature that touches the ice urchin or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 3 (1d6) piercing damage and 2 (1d4) cold.

traits.name: Venomous Spine Regrowth
traits.text: An ice urchin has twelve venomous spines. Used spines regrow when the ice urchin finishes a long rest.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.text: While motionless indistinguishable from ice-covered willow tree.

traits.name: Ice Melt
traits.text: If it takes fire damage its icicles partially melt. Until the end of the ice willow’s next turn creatures have advantage on saves vs. the willow’s Icicle Drop and Icicle Spray.

actions.name: Melting Icicles
actions.text: When the ice willow takes fire it can immediately use Icicle Drop if available.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: Can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Cold Physiology
traits.text: Can’t abide constant warmth. Each hr it spends in an area with temperature above 40 degrees Fahrenheit worm must make DC 15 Con save or suffer one level of exhaustion that can’t be removed until it finishes a long rest in area with temperature below 40 degrees.

traits.name: Heat Sensitivity
traits.text: Has disadvantage on attack rolls when within 5 ft. of a strong source of heat that isn’t a warm-blooded creature’s natural warmth such as a torch or campfire. traits.name: Slippery

traits.name: Essential Oiliness
traits.text: Has advantage on saves and ability checks made to escape a grapple or end restrained condition.

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.text: Can hold its breath for 1 hr.

A poisoned creature can re-save at end of each of its turns success ends effect on itself. Swallowed creatures are then regurgitated falling prone in a space within 10 ft. of the imperator.

traits.name: Penguin Telepathy
traits.text: Can magically command any penguin within 120' of it using a limited telepathy.

traits.name: Siege Monster
traits.text: Double damage to objects/structures.

traits.text: The imperator moves up to 30' in a straight line over ice or snow and can move through the space of any Large or smaller creature. On a success a creature takes half the damage and isn’t knocked prone.

traits.name: Wing Slap
traits.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, 10 ft., one target, 16 (2d10+5) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Muster the Legions
actions.text: When the imperator is reduced to half its hp or lower it magically calls 1d4 swarms of penguins. The penguins arrive on initiative count 20 of the next round acting as allies of the imperator and obeying its telepathic commands. The penguins remain for 1 hr until the imperator dies or until the imperator dismisses them as a bonus action.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.text: The swarm can occupy another creature’s space and vice-versa and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Med penguin. The swarm can’t regain hp or gain temp hp.

traits.name: Tobogganing Tide
traits.text: The swarm can move at double its walking speed over ice and snow.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: Can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Aqueous Form
traits.text: Can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 foot wide with o squeezing.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.text: Doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.

traits.name: Immortal Nature
traits.text: Doesn't require food drink or sleep

traits.name: Luminous
traits.text: Sheds dim light in a 5 ft. radius.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.text: Weapon attacks are magical.

actions.name: Celestial Inspiration
actions.text: Inspires one creature it can see within 60' of it. Whenever target makes attack roll or save before start of incandescent one's next turn target can roll a d4 and add number rolled to the attack roll or save.

traits.name: Amorphous
traits.text: Move through space 1ft.+ wide with o squeezing.

traits.name: Ionic Form
traits.text: Whenever subjected to lightning it takes no damage and instead regains hp equal to lightning dealt. Its Supercharge then recharges. If it takes cold while supercharged it must roll a d6. On a 1 or 2 it loses the supercharged state.

traits.name: Ooze Nature
traits.text: Doesn’t require sleep.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.text: Difficult surfaces even ceilings no ability check.

actions.name: Charged Motion
actions.text: Dash or Dodge action.

actions.name: Supercharge
actions.text: Gathers ambient electricity to supercharge itself for 3 rounds. While supercharged slime gains +2 bonus to its AC and it gains an additional action on each of its turns. At end of the third round if the slime hasn't used the Discharge action it suffers feedback taking 18 (4d8) force. Its supercharged state then ends.

traits.name: Elemental Weapons
traits.text: Its weapon attacks are imbued with its elemental power. When the jinnborn hits with any weapon the weapon deals an extra 1d6 lightning (included in the attack).

traits.name: Flamboyant Defense
traits.text: While it is wearing no armor and wielding no shield its AC includes its Cha modifier.

traits.name: Knows the Ropes
traits.text: Has proficiency with airships sandships or waterborne ships (the jinnborn’s choice). It adds its proficiency bonus to any check it makes to control the chosen type of ship and it adds its proficiency bonus to any saves made while on the chosen type of vehicle.

actions.name: Parry
actions.text: + 2 to its AC vs. one melee attack that would hit it if it can see attacker and wielding melee weapon.

traits.name: Shrill Screech
traits.text: When agitated the jubjub bird makes a near constant shrill and high scream giving it advantage on Cha (Intimidation) checks.

traits.name: Stubborn
traits.text: Has advantage on saves vs. being charmed. In addition Wis (Animal Handling) checks are made with disadvantage vs. the jubjub bird.

traits.name: Unpredictable
traits.text: Opportunity attacks vs. the jubjub bird are made with disadvantage.

actions.name: Impassioned Riposte
actions.text: When a creature the jubjub bird can see misses it with an attack while within 10 ft. of it the jubjub bird can make one Bite attack vs. the attacker.

traits.name: Aura of Honesty
traits.text: Creature that enters space within 10 ft. of sheriff for 1st time on a turn or starts turn there: DC 13 Cha save or be unable to speak deliberate lie until it starts its turn more than 10 ft. away from sheriff. Creatures affected by this are aware of it and sheriff knows whether creature in area succeeded/failed save.

traits.name: Sheriff’s Duty
traits.text: Knows if it hears a lie and can’t speak deliberate lie.

traits.name: Unfailing Memory
traits.text: Remembers every creature that has ever spoken to it. If creature has spoken to sheriff and speaks to sheriff again while polymorphed or disguised sheriff has advantage on Int (Investigation) Wis (Insight) and Wis (Perception) checks to identify or recognize that creature.

actions.name: Hop Away

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

traits.name: Elemental Nature
traits.text: Doesn’t require air food drink or sleep.

traits.text: Is surrounded by a cloud of swirling dust and small stones. On a successful save the creature is immune to the khamaseen’s Stinging Dust for the next 24 hrs.

actions.name: Shock
actions.text: If a creature wearing metal armor or wielding a metal weapon or shield moves within 5 ft. of khamaseen it takes 5 (2d4) lightning (DC 12 Dex negates).

name: Khargi
languages: understands Abyssal and Infernal but can't speak

traits.name: Deadly Infestation
traits.text: A creature that touches the khargi or hits it with melee attack while within 5 ft. of it takes 7 (2d6) poison as stinging insects rise up to protect the khargi.

traits.name: Death Swarms
traits.text: When it dies the insects crawling across and within it burst from its body forming 2d4 swarms of insects that appear in unoccupied spaces within 5 ft. of khargi’s space.

traits.name: Infested Weapons
traits.text: Its weapon attacks are magical. When it hits with any weapon deals + 2d6 poison (included below).

actions.name: Adaptive Carapace
actions.text: When it takes acid cold force lightning or thunder it can magically attune itself to that type of damage. Until end of its next turn khargi has resistance to damage of the triggering type and when it hits with any weapon target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage of the triggering type.

traits.name: Drake Mount
traits.text: Has formed a bond with Med or larger drake mount (found in this or other books or use the statistics of a giant lizard). Regardless of the drake’s intelligence it acts as a controlled mount while carrying a drake rider obeying the rider’s spoken commands. Mounting and dismounting the drake costs the drake rider only 5 ft. of movement.

traits.name: Mounted Warrior
traits.text: While the drake rider is mounted its mount can’t be charmed or frightened.

traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
traits.text: In sunlight disadvantage on attacks and Wis (Perception) checks that use sight.

traits.name: Sure Seat
traits.text: While mounted and not incapacitated the drake rider can’t be knocked prone dismounted or moved vs. its will.

traits.name: Trained Tactics (Recharge 4–6)
traits.text: The drake rider commands its mount to move up to 30' in a straight line moving through the space of any Large or smaller creature and performing one of the following tactical maneuvers. This movement doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks.Barrel Roll: The mount flies up and over one creature in the line ending its movement at least 10 ft. past the target. As the drake rider hangs upside down at the top of the loop it makes one Spear attack vs. the target with advantage. On a hit the rider rolls damage dice three times. The mount must have a flying speed to use this maneuver.Corkscrew Roll: The mount swims in a corkscrew around the creatures in the line. actions.text: The drake rider wears wing-like arm and feet flaps folded on its back. If its mount dies or it is dismounted the rider descends 60' per round and takes no damage from falling if its mount was flying or it gains a swimming speed of 30' for 1 min if its mount was swimming.

traits.name: Hand Crossbow

actions.text: The ghost hunter launches its grappling hook at a Large or larger object or structure or at a Huge or larger creature it can see within 60' of it and is pulled to an unoccupied space within 5 ft. of the target with o provoking opportunity attacks.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: Advantage on attacks vs. creature if 1+ unincapacitated attacker ally is within 5 ft. of target.

traits.name: Planar Weapons

traits.name: Planes Hunter

languages: understands Void Speech but can't speak

actions.text: Attaches a symbiotic tether to a creature sitting in the recess in its back. traits.text: Senses magic within 120' of it at will. This otherwise works like the detect magic spell but isn’t itself magical.

actions.text: When a creature wanderer can see within 30' of it casts spell wanderer can absorb spell's energy countering it. If it successfully counters the spell it gains 5 temp hp/spell level.

actions.name: Drain Magic Item
actions.text: Drains the magic from an item it is holding. Magic item with charges loses 1d6 charges item with limited uses per day loses one daily use and single-use item such as potion or spell scroll is destroyed. All other magic items have their effects suppressed for 1 min. Wanderer gains 5 temp hp each time it drains a magic item. A drained item regains its magic after 24 hrs.

traits.name: Draw Life Essence
traits.text: Can spend 10 min coaxing life essence out of willing creature taking only agreed amount of time from creature’s max lifetime. Essence appears as rosy mist that rises from mouth nose or skin of creature and snakes into carved crystal vial in broker’s cloak where it takes the form of a crimson liquid. Creature that drinks such a vial gains life stored within it provided broker gave vial willingly. If broker draws all remaining life from creature creature dies and can be returned to life only via wish spell.

traits.name: Life Reading
traits.text: If it spends 1 min studying a mortal creature it can see within 30' of it broker can determine the remainder of that creature’s natural life to the second.

traits.text: Advantage: spell/magic effect saves.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.text: While motionless indistinguishable from normal rock.

traits.text: When it starts its turn within 5 ft. of a source of light light is reduced while eater remains within 100' of light source. Bright light becomes dim and dim becomes darkness. If eater reduces light source’s light to darkness eater sheds multicolored bright light in 20' radius and dim light for additional 20' for 1 hr and light source is extinguished if it is nonmagical flame or dispelled if it was created by 2nd level or lower spell.

traits.name: Light Sense
